title: Cloud task run lifecycle: API → facade → Temporal process-task
answers: How does a task run get started and executed?
Where is the process_task workflow and its activities?
Where is TaskRun model and facade?
How are run status changes applied?
body:
- HTTP: `presentation/views/api.py:TaskViewSet.run` → facade `create_and_run_task`/`create_run` → `temporal/client.py:execute_task_processing_workflow` (async twin exists) → workflow `process-task`.
- Status: `TaskRunViewSet.partial_update` → `facade/api.py:update_task_run`; cancel via `TaskRunViewSet.cancel`; `signal_workflow_completion` sends `ProcessTaskWorkflow.complete_task` (best-effort).
- Workflow: `temporal/process_task/workflow.py:ProcessTaskWorkflow.run` → `_get_task_processing_context` (activity get_task_processing_context) → `_provision_and_start_agent` (in_progress, `_get_sandbox_for_repository`, `_run_wizard_if_configured`, `_start_agent_server`, `_await_agent_server_ready`) → side loops (event relay, credential refresh) → `_wait_for_event` main loop. finally: cleanup via `_read_sandbox_logs`/`_cleanup_sandbox`, skipped on continue_as_new (`ResumedSandboxState` carries sandbox).
- Activities: one module each in `temporal/process_task/activities/`, registered in `temporal/__init__.py`.
- Model: `models.py:TaskRun` (state/output/artifacts JSON). Mutate `state` only via `update_state_atomic`/`mutate_state_atomic`/`update_output_atomic`.
- `temporal/process_task/README.md` is stale (cites old `backend/services/sandbox.py`; real path `logic/services/sandbox.py`).
